queries: NVIDIA first quarter fiscal 2025 results data center revenue record net income
Microsoft FY24 Q3 earnings call Azure growth 7 points AI services
PwC 2024 AI Jobs Barometer job postings requiring AI skills grew

sources_considered.why: Reports Nvidia's profit and that the CEO credits generative AI demand for it.
Reports AI's share of Azure growth and the count of paid GitHub Copilot subscribers.
Context on job postings that require AI skills. It covers AI broadly, not generative AI alone.

receipt.public_excerpt: Nvidia's GAAP net income for Q1 FY 2025 was $14.881 billion, up 21% from $12.285 billion in the previous quarter and up a whopping 628% from $2.043 billion in the same quarter a year before.

evidence_items.explanation: Nvidia earned large profits in the quarter ending April 2024. Read with e2, this contradicts 'isn't making anybody any money'.

receipt.public_excerpt: "Our datacenter growth was fueled by strong and accelerating demand for generative AI training and inference on the Hopper platform," said Jensen Huang

evidence_items.explanation: The company credits generative AI demand for its record growth.

metric_scope.metric: Data center revenue growth attributed to generative AI

evidence_items.locator: paragraph after the capacity bottleneck note

receipt.public_excerpt: Microsoft's GitHub Copilot code-generation tool now has 1.8 million paid subscribers

evidence_items.explanation: 1.8 million people paid for a generative AI coding tool. That suggests some new ways of doing work and some revenue. It is context, not a measure of new jobs.

receipt.public_excerpt: PwC research also finds that growth in jobs demanding AI skills has outpaced all jobs since 2016, with postings for jobs requiring AI skills growing 3.5x faster than for all jobs.

evidence_items.explanation: Job postings that require AI skills grew fast. This covers AI broadly, not generative AI alone, so it does not settle the jobs part.

unresolved_gaps: No source isolates jobs created by generative AI in particular as of mid-2024.
'New ways to do your job' has no agreed measure.
